data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to list, retrieve, and display images and videos from the native mobile gallery.
data.what_it_does: It provides APIs to list albums, fetch media items, obtain files, thumbnails, and full‑size images from the device's photo library. It also includes widgets for displaying thumbnails and full images.
use_when: You need to access the device's photo gallery for browsing or selecting media.
You want platform‑specific thumbnail generation and file access without building native code yourself.
avoid_when: You only need to pick a single image or video (use image_picker).
You require cross‑platform web support (this plugin is Android/iOS only).
strengths: Comprehensive album and media listing APIs
Built‑in thumbnail providers for efficient image display
weaknesses: Requires native permission configuration on both platforms
Limited to gallery access; no camera capture
data.setup_notes: Add NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist; add READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO permissions to AndroidManifest.xml; no build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler API for picking a single image or video without album browsing.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides advanced image zooming and panning for displaying full‑size images.
